title: Understanding a bill
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Monthly bills list the plan fee, extra usage, roaming charges and adjustments separately. View the itemised bill in the DemoTel app under Billing. To dispute an unexpected charge, contact support within 30 days of the bill date. Support reviews the charge; a refund is not guaranteed.

title: Bill payment and late payment
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Pay bills through the DemoTel app or a DemoTel service store. Payment is due 14 days after the bill is issued. If payment is late, outgoing services may be suspended after a reminder. Contact support to discuss payment assistance; the assistant cannot process payments or promise a waiver.

title: Cancellation and contract closure
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Request cancellation through support or a DemoTel service store after identity verification. Pay any outstanding balance. A contract may have an early termination fee; support must check the individual agreement. The assistant cannot cancel a line or calculate an individual termination fee.

title: International roaming activation
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Before travelling abroad, enable international roaming in the DemoTel app and confirm destination coverage with support. A roaming bundle must be activated before use. Calls, SMS and mobile data outside a bundle can incur extra charges. The FAQ does not list destination-specific prices or coverage.

title: Available mobile plans
text: Fictional DemoTel catalogue: Flex Start costs EGP 120 per month and includes 6 GB of data and 200 local minutes. Flex Plus costs EGP 220 per month and includes 15 GB of data and 500 local minutes. These are fictional portfolio examples, not real offers. Extra usage is charged separately; the FAQ does not specify extra-usage rates.

title: Changing a mobile plan
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Request a plan change in the app under My Plan or contact support. A change takes effect at the next billing cycle. Existing contractual commitments must be checked by support. No retention discount is guaranteed. The assistant can explain options but cannot modify a subscription.

title: Customer support and complaints
text: Fictional DemoTel support is available through in-app chat daily from 09:00 to 21:00 Egypt time, or at a DemoTel service store. For complaints, obtain a reference number and keep the related bill or service details. The assistant does not have access to real support systems or live case status.

title: Data allowance and usage alerts
text: Fictional DemoTel policy: Check remaining mobile data in the app under Usage. Usage alerts are sent at 80% and 100% of the bundle. Unused monthly data expires at the billing-cycle end; it does not roll over. When the allowance is exhausted, turn off mobile data or ask support about an add-on. Add-on prices are not included in these FAQs.
